security_audit.summary: Many static backtick findings are Markdown syntax, model identifiers, or example boundaries, not Ruby execution. The meaningful risk is intended external CLI use: the skill can run inference.sh commands that authenticate, launch remote video jobs, and may consume account credits. No prompt injection text was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Replace `Bash(infsh *)` with narrower allowed commands for the documented Pruna app runs and list command. Require explicit approval before login, installs, or paid generation.

remediation.issue: External media and cost side effects
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before sending image or audio URLs to inference.sh, and confirm model, resolution, duration, and credit use before running jobs.
Use a bundled marketplace image or remove the remote image URL to avoid third-party asset loading in rendered documentation.

content.value_statement: AI video generation can require separate tools for text, image, audio, and model selection. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Pruna P-Video and WAN runs using the inference.sh CLI.
actual_capabilities: Run Pruna P-Video text-to-video examples through the infsh CLI.
Animate image URLs with P-Video or WAN-I2V inputs.
Pass audio URLs to P-Video for synchronized video generation.
Select 480p, 720p, 1080p, duration, and draft options shown in SKILL.md.
List Pruna apps through the inference.sh CLI namespace command.
Compare P-Video, WAN-T2V, and WAN-I2V use cases.
limitations: Requires an installed inference.sh CLI and a valid account login.
Commands contact inference.sh services and may consume account credits.
Examples use external image and audio URLs rather than local upload workflows.
Output quality, generation time, and pricing depend on the selected Pruna model.

use_cases.title: Create Concept Videos
use_cases.description: Marketing teams can turn short prompts into draft clips for campaign review.

use_cases.title: Animate Product Images
use_cases.description: Designers can test motion from product or portrait image URLs before final asset production.

use_cases.title: Prototype Media Pipelines
use_cases.description: Developers can compare P-Video and WAN model calls while planning automated video workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Use p-video to create a five second 720p clip from this prompt: [describe scene]. Ask before running any command that may use credits.

prompt_templates.title: Animate an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use p-video to animate this image URL with subtle camera motion: [URL]. Include the model choice and ask for confirmation before running infsh.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Choices
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare P-Video, WAN-T2V, and WAN-I2V for this video goal: [goal]. Recommend resolution, duration, and draft settings before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Video Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an inference.sh video workflow for [campaign or pipeline]. Include prompts, model selection, cost checks, and approval points before any CLI run.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a sunset beach clip.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects P-Video, proposes a five second 720p run, asks for credit approval, then prepares the CLI action.

output_examples.input: A designer provides a portrait image URL.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends WAN-I2V or P-Video, describes the motion prompt, and requests confirmation before sending the URL to inference.sh.
The assistant explains draft mode and WAN resolution choices, then outlines a safe approval step before launching generation.

best_practices: Confirm model, resolution, duration, and credit use before running infsh commands.
Use trusted image and audio URLs that the user has permission to process.
Start with draft or 480p settings when exploring concepts.
anti_patterns: Do not run login, install, or generation commands without explicit user approval.
Do not send private media URLs to inference.sh without confirming sharing rights.
Do not promise fixed prices or quality when the model pricing and outputs can change.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps run Pruna P-Video and WAN video models through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples include infsh login, so an inference.sh account is expected.

faq.question: Can it animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes P-Video and WAN-I2V examples that use image URLs.

faq.question: Can it add audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The P-Video examples include an audio URL input for synchronized video.

faq.question: Is it safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The CLI can contact external services and may use credits, so commands should require confirmation.
